entities.name: UniProt Q54X95
observations: Exact 736-aa sequence match to reviewed Dictyostelium discoideum probable cytoplasmic methionine--tRNA ligase (100% identity and coverage).
Annotated activity: methionine-tRNA ligase; GO:0004825. Catalyzes methionyl-tRNA aminoacylation (GO:0006431).
Annotated localization: cytoplasm/cytosol; associated with aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase and methionyl-glutamyl tRNA synthetase complexes.
Pfam matches: tRNA-synt_1, tRNA-synt_1g, Anticodon_3, and tRNA_bind.

entities.name: Methionyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: GO:0006431 process annotated for the exact-match methionine--tRNA ligase; enzyme charges tRNA with methionine for translation.
